carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a high-intensity highlight on the dorsal edge and a distinct shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered near the anterior base; the distal and posterior regions of the fin silhouette show low-contrast, uniform pixel values.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance, elongated linear feature is attached to the dorsal midline immediately anterior to the first dorsal fin, consistent with an ectoparasite or remora.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region and the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibit a dense population of significantly smaller, non-grid-aligned spots compared to the lateral flank.
